svg.aria-label: What the gateway hardens versus what it deliberately leaves out: capped request bodies, SSRF-checked and signed webhooks, bearer auth and restart-surviving idempotency on one side; no per-key identity, no rate limiting, no rebinding-proof delivery and no cross-process queue on the other.

svg.text: Not flagged is not the same as safe: without per-key identity, any holder of the shared key can read any job by id.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The unguessable UUID is not an ownership check, and this README says so rather than letting the reader assume otherwise.
